data.description: Implement and prove the Phase 2B C3 hard gate before structural root moves. Add an isolated temporary pack-root harness for the future public hive-flow package, rewrite workspace:* runtime specs to concrete source versions, stage bundled eager runtime workspaces without mutating repo node_modules, run npm pack --dry-run --json and tarball install into a temp prefix, verify hive-flow --version, selected import probes, MCP server path availability, provider bridge/journal imports, and tarball exclusions for maps, __tests__, db files, .hive-flow, DELETE trash, checkpoints, and local runtime state. Route implementation to Claude before landing.
